text:
rachel: Quick heads-up: we just shipped Maintainers Toolkit v0.8.0 to GH releases — lightweight CLI + linting helpers for community repos. https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers-toolkit/releases/tag/v0.8.0 :tada:
jorge: nice! what's the install path?
rachel: pip + npm: `pip install maintainers-toolkit==0.8.0` and `npm i @redwood-inference/maintainers-toolkit@0.8.0`. there's also a tiny standalone binary for linux/macos in the assets.
release-bot: release-bot: CI pipeline green for v0.8.0 (build 1234) :white_check_mark:
leo: any breaking changes?
rachel: minor: `mtk check` now defaults to config in `maintain.yaml` instead of `.mtkrc`. we include an automatic migration helper: `mtk migrate-config --dry-run`. old flags are deprecated but will continue to work for two releases.
jorge: awesome. we added an opt-in GitHub Action that posts suggested labels on PRs, fyi. docs-bot: docs-bot: docs build succeeded for release/v0.8.0 :rocket:
leo: who's monitoring GH discussions after the post?
rachel: tagging jorge as point contact for 48h, i'm on standby for escalations. jorge: i'll monitor and triage.
jorge: marketing blurb: "Maintainers Toolkit v0.8.0 1: streamlined linting, safer config migration, and optional PR labeling automation." i'll push to #community-updates and the newsletter.
rachel: thanks all 1. if you see install regressions ping me or jorge directly.
